title: A SUMMARIZE extension column sees the group-by column in a row context and in the filter context
query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZE ( Sales, Product[Color], "Color 1", Product[Color], "Color 2", SELECTEDVALUE ( Product[Color] ) )

source.quote: Color 1 is based on the row context, which contains only the cluster headers. Color 2 and Color 3 rely on the filter context.
source.supports: the article shows this query and says each column repeats the colour

derivation: Groups are Red and Blue (the colours with sales). The bare column reference reads the group header from the row context; SELECTEDVALUE reads the single colour visible in the filter context of the cluster.
